events.title: The surgeon asks for the open set
events.label: ProcSense educational extension
events.cue: The surgeon says dense adhesions make the keyhole view poor and asks for the open set.

responses.label: Ask the scrub nurse to open the open set and say so aloud
Tell the anaesthetist the operation may be converted to open

events.title: Bleeding that needs suction
events.label: ProcSense educational extension
events.cue: There is bleeding at the operative site and the surgeon asks for suction.

responses.label: Check the suction is working and tell the team it is ready
Tell the anaesthetist there is bleeding

events.title: An unexpected finding
events.label: ProcSense educational extension
events.cue: The surgeon reports an unexpected finding, a stone in the duct, and says the plan may change.

responses.label: Acknowledge it and relay it to the anaesthetist and the circulating nurse
Say you will include it in the Sign Out and recovery handover

events.title: A normal-looking appendix
events.label: ProcSense educational extension
events.cue: The surgeon says the appendix looks normal and decides to remove it anyway.

responses.label: Make sure the specimen will be labelled and sent, and say so
Relay the finding to the anaesthetist and note it for the handover
